dedupe_keys.name: eurostat farm structure irrigation statistics irrigated area equipment and water payment by region

description: Eurostat publishes irrigation results of its farm structure surveys and integrated farm statistics in several tables. The 2023 table ef_mp_tpirri gives the number of holdings and irrigable area by irrigation equipment, its state of maintenance and the payment terms for irrigation water, by NUTS 2 region (about 112,000 observations); older tables give holdings, irrigated areas and equipment by size of irrigated area and region for 2005 to 2013 (ef_poirrig, about 210,000 observations) and by farm size for 1990 to 2007 (ef_lu_ofirrig). All are free in the Eurostat data browser, as bulk TSV or CSV and through the SDMX and JSON APIs under Eurostat's reuse policy (CC BY 4.0). Caveats: coverage is regional statistics for EU and some EFTA countries, definitions and breakdowns change between survey rounds, and no table describes individual schemes or canals. Simulation uses: regional irrigation equipment and irrigated area for capacity planning and drought adaptation of irrigation. Related records: the FAO Global Map of Irrigation Areas (data-fao-global-map-of-irrigation-areas).
name: Eurostat farm structure irrigation statistics (irrigated area, equipment and water payment by region)
notes: Breakdowns in schema_summary combine the table labels with the harvested German and French descriptions; the tables did not render headlessly.
